_appid: Never on Steam. A 2008 Nintendo-published DS title; Pokémon is Nintendo/Creatures/Game Freak first-party and has never shipped on Steam, so Steam matching is pinned off rather than left to fuzzy-match something unrelated. Same treatment as the Guardian Signs sibling.
_lutris: The directory, flake attr and name all use Lutris's slug verbatim, including the odd `--1` suffix: https://lutris.net/api/games/pokemon-ranger-shadows-of-almia--1 is the real entry (name "Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia", 2008) and the un-suffixed `pokemon-ranger-shadows-of-almia` does not exist. AGENTS.md requires dir = flake attr = Lutris slug, and the launcher fetches banner art BY SLUG, so do not "fix" the suffix.
description: Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia (2008 Creatures Inc., Nintendo DS, via RetroArch / melonDS)
long: Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia is the second Pokémon Ranger action-RPG for the Nintendo DS, set in the Almia region as a rookie Ranger training at the Ranger School. Wild Pokémon are befriended by drawing loops around them on the touch screen with the Capture Styler under time pressure, then lend their Poké Assist powers to clear obstacles and finish missions. Partner Pokémon and a darker Team Dim Sun plot distinguish it from the first game. The whole capture mechanic is stylus-driven, including the attract screen, so this package follows the input device: mouse pointer when no pad is attached, right stick plus R3 as the stylus when one is.
